meta.title: Grove
meta.description: Open Grove from the left sidebar after installing: connect your Obsidian vault, capture a first idea, then return to the conversation and let AI question it, compare explanations, and look for counterexamples. Notes stay as Markdown in the vault's Grove/ folder, ready to revisit, revise, and share; content drafted by AI is saved only after you confirm it in the terminal. Grove reads and writes only that subfolder.
